name: Theme Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Every Omarchy theme in one list, user and system: apply, hide or delete a theme, and manage each theme's wallpapers. Add them by drag & drop from the file manager or straight from a web page, by pasting, or by web search; iPhone HEIC photos are converted. Hidden themes and wallpapers also disappear from Omarchy's own pickers. Browse and install new themes from omarchy.org. A movable floating popup that stays open while you work.
